Entities / Characters / Sienne Orre

Sienne Orre

RoleCaptain, [[fernen
StatusDeceased — soul inside [[delmar-fisk

Sienne captained the Fernen, the fleet’s fourth vessel. Druid, capable of wildshaping into aquatic forms. She ran the second underwater scout team alongside Maren during the perimeter survey of Umberlee’s shrine island. She was outside the cave when the fleet sank.

Her soul was pressed into Delmar at the moment of sinking, along with the other four captains.

Appearance & Manner

Silver-streaked hair cut close, older than her role implied she needed to be. She carries that without embarrassment. Unhurried — she moves like someone who has learned that rushing produces worse information. Wherever she goes, she is writing something down.

The Voice

Meticulous report delivered after three drafts. Worn by how rarely other people come as prepared as she does.

At table:

“We have the perimeter, we have the chart, and we have one piece that isn’t matching. I need five minutes.” “I know it’s not what you wanted to hear. I wrote down what I saw.”

Mortis — When She Surfaces

Trigger (forced)Targeted by 2nd+ level spell, or fails Int save
Trigger (env)Green mermaid sign/figurehead/carving — wistfulness, asks how long it’s been there
Skills grantedArcana, Investigation
Personality shiftMethodical, careful. Slows down, wants more info before committing.
CueAsks questions instead of answering. Charm quiets. Almost professorial.

Backstory

She kept a room at the Green Mermaid — a harborside tavern in Kettermoor — where she stored fourteen years of research notes. Tide charts, druidic correspondences, migration patterns, contracts annotated in the margins. She had been meaning to organize them properly. She did not get to.

She went to sea because the sea had a set of systems she didn’t yet understand, and she was constitutionally incapable of leaving a system unexplained.

Relationships

  • Delmar Fisk — admiral; now carries her soul
  • The Fernen — her ship
  • Fisk’s Fleet — her fleet
  • Maren — ran the second scout team with her

Pressure Points

  • She surfaces when magic targets Delmar directly — investigation replaces action.
  • The Green Mermaid sign or figurehead is the quietest trigger: wistfulness, a question about how long it’s been there.
